import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings
import re

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# 1. TF-IDF features (word-level)
tfidf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train_word = tfidf_word.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_test_word = tfidf_word.transform(test_df["text"])

# 2. TF-IDF features (character-level)
tfidf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=3000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_char = tfidf_char.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_test_char = tfidf_char.transform(test_df["text"])


# 3. Stylometric features
def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        word_count = len(text.split())
        char_count = len(text)
        avg_word_len = char_count / max(word_count, 1)
        exclamation_count = text.count("!")
        question_count = text.count("?")
        comma_count = text.count(",")
        semicolon_count = text.count(";")
        colon_count = text.count(":")
        ellipsis_count = text.count("...")
        upper_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
        features.append(
            [
                word_count,
                char_count,
                avg_word_len,
                exclamation_count,
                question_count,
                comma_count,
                semicolon_count,
                colon_count,
                ellipsis_count,
                upper_count,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)


X_train_stylo = extract_stylometric_features(train_df["text"].values)
X_test_stylo = extract_stylometric_features(test_df["text"].values)

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_stylo_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_stylo)
X_test_stylo_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_stylo)

X_train_combined = np.hstack(
    [X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray(), X_train_stylo_scaled]
)
X_test_combined = np.hstack(
    [X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray(), X_test_stylo_scaled]
)

y = train_df["author"].map({"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2})

X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_train_split, label=y_train)
dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val_split, label=y_val)

params = {
    "objective": "multi:softprob",
    "num_class": 3,
    "max_depth": 5,
    "eta": 0.05,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "seed": 42,
    "silent": True,
    "nthread": -1,
    "eval_metric": "mlogloss",
}

evals_result = {}
model = xgb.train(
    params,
    dtrain,
    num_boost_round=500,
    evals=[(dtrain, "train"), (dval, "val")],
    evals_result=evals_result,
    verbose_eval=False,
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
)

# Find best iteration from evals_result
val_losses = evals_result["val"]["mlogloss"]
best_round = int(np.argmin(val_losses)) + 1  # XGBoost rounds are 1-indexed in logs

# Validation prediction using model at best round
val_proba = model.predict(dval)
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_proba)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

# Train final model on full data for submission (with fixed rounds)
dtrain_full = xgb.DMatrix(X_train_combined, label=y)
model_full = xgb.train(
    params,
    dtrain_full,
    num_boost_round=best_round,
    verbose_eval=False,
)

# Predict on test set
dtest = xgb.DMatrix(X_test_combined)
test_proba = model_full.predict(dtest)

submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": test_proba[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_proba[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_proba[:, 2],
    }
)

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
